News / TradingView / Key facts: NVDA to Buy Hugging Face $13B; Q2 $96B; US Clears AI Chips

Key facts: NVDA to Buy Hugging Face $13B; Q2 $96B; US Clears AI Chips Less than 1 min read

NVDA NVIDIA to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9–$13.0B. Deal gives NVIDIA access to ~18M developers and open-model ecosystem; Hugging Face to remain open and multi-cloud compatible.

3 sources NVIDIA (NVDA) Q2 revenue $96B; Q3 guidance ~ $108B; full-year revenue expected > $411B, implying ~70% YoY growth. Invezz U.S. cleared expanded sales of NVIDIA (NVDA) AI chips to support Armenia’s Firebird data-center as part of a preliminary Armenia-Azerbaijan peace deal, tying chip access to the project. Dow Jones Newswires NVIDIA's RTX Spark desktops launch in October via Lenovo and Acer. They pair Blackwell GPU with Grace CPU, offer up to 1 petaflop AI performance and up to 128GB unified memory for local AI. GuruFocus NVIDIA (NVDA) eyes about $2B convertible note in Nscale’s $3.5B pre-IPO round; notes at double‑digit discount, convert with cap up to $30B. Goldman Sachs coordinating; Third Point to lead. Reuters NVIDIA (NVDA) is negotiating a $2.5 billion investment in Thinking Machines Lab, likely covering about half of a $5–6 billion round that would value the company at $40+ billion. GuruFocus NVIDIA (NVDA) partners with Figure to train Helix robotics models on NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin, validate in Isaac Sim, and deploy on NVIDIA-powered robots, aiming to scale robotics data and ecosystem. Benzinga Rosenblatt maintained a Buy rating on NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) and kept a price target of $390 per share.
